description: This file defines the OrderMapper class, which maps Order domain entities to Data Transfer Objects (DTOs) for API responses in a Java Spring project. It converts Order and OrderItem entities into corresponding response DTOs.

classes.name: OrderMapper
classes.description: A Spring component that maps Order entities to API DTOs for responses.

methods.name: toResponse
methods.description: Converts an Order entity into an OrderResponse DTO, including mapping the list of OrderItems.

methods.name: toItemResponses
methods.description: Converts a list of OrderItem entities into a list of OrderItemResponse DTOs.

methods.name: toResponse
methods.description: Converts an individual OrderItem entity into an OrderItemResponse DTO.
